test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A lender lends Rs. 10,000 at 8\% per annum simple interest for t years and then lends an additional Rs. 5,000 at 12\% per annum simple interest for the same period t . If the total simple interest at the end of t years is 5,400 , find t (in years).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total annual interest = (10000 × 8%) + (5000 × 12%)

Annual Interest = 800 + 600 = ₹1400

Total time t = Total Simple Interest ÷ Annual Interest

t = 5400 ÷ 1400 = 27 ÷ 7 ≈ 3.86 years

**∴ The correct answer is 3.86 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Principal₁ (P₁) = ₹10,000, Rate₁ (R₁) = 8%

Given: Principal₂ (P₂) = ₹5,000, Rate₂ (R₂) = 12%

Total Simple Interest (SI) = ₹5,400, Time = t years

Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/830e863a178474868565d0bee94947fe5ceac6d1deedb2f974638dc78b857f19.png] 

⇒ SI₁ = (10000 × 8 × t) ÷ 100 = 800t

⇒ SI₂ = (5000 × 12 × t) ÷ 100 = 600t

⇒ Total SI = SI₁ + SI₂

⇒ 5400 = 800t + 600t

⇒ 5400 = 1400t

⇒ t = 5400 ÷ 1400

⇒ t = 54 ÷ 14 = 27 ÷ 7

⇒ t ≈ 3.86 years

**∴ The correct answer is 3.86 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI) Formula

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is Principal, R is Rate per annum, and T is Time in years.

Total Amount Formula

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI) = P × (1 + (R × T) ÷ 100).

Effective Rate of Interest

When multiple investments are made, the combined rate Rₑff = (ΣPᵢRᵢ) ÷ ΣPᵢ.
